description: From a regular expression to automata, as in the Dragon book: the Thompson epsilon-NFA, the DFA by subset construction (with the set of NFA states behind each DFA state) and the minimal DFA by partition refinement, each as a transition table (→ start, * accepting). Optionally tests words against it. Syntax: single-letter or digit symbols, | * + ? ( ) and ε. Returns a link that shows every construction step.

words.description: Words to test; "" or "ε" is the empty word

name: automata_from_regex
